messages:
Priya (AE): hey team — Qbotics just filed an onboarding request for a hybrid ensemble (7B summarizer + 3B reranker) for maintenance logs. They need private deployment + HSM for keys and PHI redaction. asking for timing and risk to renewal if we can't meet their compliance window
Maya (CS): thanks — can you paste the compliance window and expected traffic? also any sample posts with PHI?
Priya (AE): compliance window = contract says go-live by 2025-07-15. traffic: steady 30 req/s peak 120 req/s during batch ingest windows. sample payloads attached in the ticket (pseudonymized) — but they said some entries include patient ids and device serials
Jared (Solutions): ok first pass: Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated GPUs. HSM/KMS + no egress of raw logs. we should propose canary with 1 shard then scale. need latency SLOs from them — what are p99/avg targets?
Priya (AE): they want p99 < 400ms for the summarizer end-to-end and reranker tail <200ms. cost sensitivity moderate, but compliance trumps cost. renewal risk: high if not live by date (executive flagged)
Maya (CS): safety asks — require deterministic PHI redaction step and audit logs per request. suggest eval criteria: false negative rate for PHI < 0.1%, and precision for redaction > 99% on held-out test set. can Solutions own the eval harness?
Jared (Solutions): yes we can own the harness. plan: 1) baseline with open 7B on Dedicated T4 cluster; 2) reranker on same pool quantized to int8; 3) run PHI redaction model in-line before sending to summarizer. we'll produce a reproducible script and dataset split.
Samir (Runtime): couple notes from runtime: merging reranker + summarizer in-series means KV cache size and memory footprint matters. for 30 req/s steady, 120 peak we should target 4 dedicated inference workers (A100 would be ideal, T4 might be borderline for 7B + reranker). need to validate token-length distribution. also we can enable prefix KV caching to cut cost if logs often repeat.

onboard-bot: checklist created: 1) sample dataset + PHI labels uploaded to secure S3 (private) 2) KMS/HSM request ticket #QBOT-424 3) dedicated capacity estimate pending 4) eval harness owner = Jared 5) security review slot requested
Maya (CS): priorities for onboarding package from Qbotics: (a) upload 500-1k labeled examples for PHI redaction, (b) target PII schema they care about, (c) confirm allowed model variants (they prefer open Llama-v2 style but ok w/ our curated 7B), (d) confirm network egress rules
Priya (AE): I asked the customer for the labeled set and the PII schema (they said device_serial, patient_id, name, free-text notes). also asked to confirm whether they can accept staged preprod in their VPC for validation
Jared (Solutions): next steps from us: draft a 2-week pilot plan: week1 = ingest & redaction eval, week2 = latency/load runs + security assessment. deliverables: eval report + cost estimate + runbook for failover. aiming to get pilot start by 2025-05-20 to hit go-live date.
Samir (Runtime): I'll run a quick perf sweep on our 7B quant profile and share memory/throughput numbers by EOD tomorrow. if A100 is required we'll flag cost and lead time. also recommend we include automatic fallback to a lower-latency model for UI-facing short summaries to keep p99 in check.
Maya (CS): noted. I'll queue the exec escalation template in case pilot slips. also: capture CS health metric "onboard-critical-path" for account dashboard so AMs see renewal risk updates.
Priya (AE): thanks all — I'll update Qbotics with the pilot timeline and request the labeled data + permission for preprod VPC testing. ping me if you need access to the ticket or the sample files. :thumbsup:
